description: GitNexus graph/index quality baseline queries (API-only focus)

kpiQueries.title: API route nodes (services/api/src/routes)
kpiQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' RETURN count(r) as value

kpiQueries.title: Polluted test route handlers
kpiQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath CONTAINS '/test/' RETURN count(r) as value

kpiQueries.title: Polluted mobile route handlers
kpiQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/mobile/' RETURN count(r) as value

kpiQueries.title: API routes with responseKeys
kpiQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' AND size(r.responseKeys) > 0 RETURN count(r) as value

kpiQueries.title: API routes with middleware
kpiQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' AND size(r.middleware) > 0 RETURN count(r) as value

validationQueries.title: Polluted handlers outside services/api/src/routes
validationQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE NOT r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' RETURN r.filePath as filePath, count(*) as routeCount ORDER BY routeCount DESC LIMIT 50

validationQueries.title: API route density by handler file
validationQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' RETURN r.filePath as filePath, count(*) as routeCount ORDER BY routeCount DESC LIMIT 50

validationQueries.title: API routes missing responseKeys
validationQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' AND size(r.responseKeys) = 0 RETURN r.filePath as filePath, r.name as route LIMIT 200

validationQueries.title: API routes missing middleware
validationQueries.query: MATCH (r:Route) WHERE r.filePath STARTS WITH 'services/api/src/routes/' AND size(r.middleware) = 0 RETURN r.filePath as filePath, r.name as route LIMIT 200
